title: Strongly Connected Components
statement:
Implement Kosaraju’s algorithm to answer whether two vertices can reach each other.

Input
n m q, then m directed edges, then q lines u v.

Output
Print YES if u and v are in the same strongly connected component, otherwise NO.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000. Endpoints are in [1,n]. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000.
